title.narrative: Protecting the Right of Development for Palestinian Communities through Advocacy and Support of Human Rights Defenders

description.narrative:
OO:Promote and protect the right to development through addressing human rights and fundamental freedoms for Palestinian communities under threat by forcible transfer by strengthening the role of human rights defenders. SO: Protection of communities (and high-risk groups therein, children and women above all) from threat of forcible transfer and related human rights violations is strengthened through the enhanced role of community human rights defenders.

Outcomes: 1.1   Human-rights defenders, clustered by geography, capable to strategize and document/address human rights violations in their communities.

2.1   Human-rights defenders contribute to community-driven national level campaigns involving advocacy and legal mechanisms.

3.1   Duty-bearers are sensitized to the violations addressed by the Action (as leveraged through third country engagement), at a national and international level toward holding them to account.
